composition_subtypes.role: sort both players' lists in ascending order to enable efficient access to largest elements
greedy decision: at each turn, compare largest elements; if own larger take it, else remove opponent's largest

payload.core_composition_summary: Sorting enables greedy selection by always comparing the largest available elements, leading to O(n log n) optimal play simulation.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts both lists, then simulates turns using a greedy rule based on largest elements, demonstrating composition of sorting and greedy algorithms.
